name: OCR + Layout (Windows.Media.Ocr)
purpose: Recognize the text in one image and return it with per-word pixel bounding boxes and lines in reading order, by driving the system Windows.Media.Ocr engine inside a Windows PowerShell 5.1 worker (pwsh 7 cannot load the WinRT projection) and reading the worker's meta file. Resolves the OCR engine from models.json, decoupled from the gateway's wired gate. First image/document perception module and the first genuinely parallel-safe perception skill: populates a documented legibility confidence + model_provenance and routes low-confidence / no-text results to the review queue. Can compose capture.screen (Module 6) as its input source.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path> (image; required unless -Capture); -Language <bcp47>; -Engine <model_id>|-Model <id>; -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1>; -MaxReviewLines <n>; -Capture; -CaptureInputsJson '<json>'; -MinImagePixels <n>; -Registry/-OcrWorkerPath/-Powershell51Path/-CapturePath/-PwshPath/-ReviewQueuePath <override>. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,language,engine,model,confidence_threshold,max_review_lines,capture,capture_inputs,min_image_pixels,registry,ocr_worker_path,powershell51_path,capture_path,pwsh_path,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the source image (png/jpg/bmp/tif/gif — whatever BitmapDecoder accepts). Required unless capture=true.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: BCP-47 recognizer language tag (e.g. en-US). Empty = the engine's user-profile / first available recognizer.

inputs.name: engine
inputs.description: OCR engine model_id in models.json (type=ocr). MVP implements engine=windows.media.ocr; ocr.tesseract is declared but not wired.

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Overall legibility confidence below this routes the result to the review queue (verify_ocr); lines below it are marked low_confidence.

inputs.name: max_review_lines
inputs.description: Cap on the worst lines carried in the review item detail (worst-confidence first).

inputs.name: capture
inputs.description: When true and no input is given, compose capture.screen (Module 6) to produce the image, then OCR it.

inputs.name: capture_inputs
inputs.description: Inputs object passed to capture.screen when capture=true (e.g. {target:'window',title:'*Notepad*'} or {target:'monitor',monitor:'primary'}). Default: primary monitor.

inputs.name: min_image_pixels
inputs.description: A zero-word result only emits a verify_no_text review item when width*height >= this.

outputs.description: { input{path,exists,source,capture?}, image{width,height,text_angle}, engine{id,name,engine,recognizer_language,available_languages}, params{language,confidence_threshold}, text, word_count, line_count, lines[{index,text,confidence,low_confidence,bounding_rect{x,y,width,height},words[{text,x,y,width,height}]}], confidence{overall,min_line,low_confidence_lines,reason}, review{threshold,flagged_count,truncated,queue_path}, ocr{engine_env,runtime_ms,max_image_dimension} }
